LanguageData.SSC_MasterQualificationItem.label: Seed of Desire
LanguageData.SSC_MasterQualificationItem.description:
An archotech creation with a dusky violet sheen, warm to the touch, as though waiting for someone willing to accept it.

It merges with its host's body by unknown means, then slowly reveals what sort of Master it wants.

An unmarked personality outside the SSC Sex Slave role gains Master qualification from its first seed. If already qualified, one seed grants Lord of Lust and permanently locks the Master role.
An unmarked SSC Sex Slave gains Servant of Lust and a permanent Sex Slave role lock from one seed, retaining its bond.
Any existing imprint prevents use. The initial qualification use retains the original research techprint rules; research must still be completed normally.

Usage: select an unmarked pawn eligible for one of the purposes above. Right-click the seed and choose "Use Seed of Desire". After the first use grants only Master qualification, select Master in the Training tab.

More seeds: if additional seeds are difficult to obtain, load a map, open SSC mod settings and click "Debug: spawn Seed of Desire".
